premises.text: Humans are a valuable resource that technology and AI are seeking to replace
premises.evidence_span: we are disrupting the market for the most valuable resource in the world today, humans. Emerging technology and AI are seeking to replace humans.

premises.text: Current technology limits human connections to existing social graphs
premises.evidence_span: we're indexed by technology by our relationships.

premises.text: People need human conversation for support and opportunities
premises.evidence_span: what we really need is human conversation.

premises.text: Sensei connects users with humans for advice and opportunities
premises.evidence_span: Sensei is one contact with the experience of millions of people.

premises.text: Sensei's algorithm matches users with the right person based on context and intent
premises.evidence_span: our match and dispatch algorithm finds and connects you with the perfect person at the right time.

The community of Sensei users contributes to a conversation marketplace
